_about: THE CENTURY PLANT (Agave americana): a great rosette, man-high, of broad, stiff, grey-blue leaves, each tapering to a black spine with hooked teeth along its edges, the outer ones arching over; once, after decades, a mast of yellow flowers in tiers, and it dies. Its LOOK, painted into the flowers' atlas (plants/flowers.js): petal / petal2 / centre / leaf / spike -- shape, colours (a list: one a variant), throat, veins and touches. How it GROWS -- stem, leaves, blooms and their sizes -- is its recipe in plants/flowers.js (GROW).
